id: title:eli-r-ph:stop rewriting unchanged property definition rows

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces unnecessary database writes and index maintenance for the dominant path where an already-known untyped property is re-ingested without a type resolution, potentially improving ingestion throughput and reducing write amplification.
review.reason: Adds a WHERE clause AND EXCLUDED.property_type IS NOT NULL to the DO UPDATE guard, while also adding a comment explaining the rationale. Adds a test case and assertions to verify that the row is only rewritten when a type is resolved, checking xmin and property_type.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the assumption that the specific path described is dominant and untyped properties are frequently re-ingested without type resolution; this is not independently verified by the provided observations. The score is assigned based on the implementation of a correctness and performance optimization, not on demonstrated production impact.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assigned; tier requires score and score requires tier. No score assigned.
